config.name.note: secrets through secretKeyRef on Secret ci-secrets, vars through configMapKeyRef on ConfigMap ci-vars (the Secret values and ConfigMap values are not written)

expr.opaque.note: (only opaque expressions of the argo dialect; a {{= expr }} text from an Argo file is written back, others are lost)

job.allow_failure.note: DAG task continueOn failed (continueOn does not combine with depends, so the emitter writes dependencies for such a task)

job.artifacts.note: template outputs artifacts under /workspace (the artifact repository ConfigMap is external; artifacts save only from the container named main, one path per artifact (a second path gets a numbered name), a glob is not expanded and an expiry is lost)

job.cache.note: PVC from volumeClaimTemplates (the cache lives for one Workflow unless the PVC is shared; tasks on different nodes need ReadWriteMany)

job.container.note: image on every container of the containerSet

job.env.note: copied into the env of every container of the set (a step variable of the same name wins)

job.environment.note: (Argo has no environment name or URL)

job.environment.approval.note: suspend template as a gate task (Argo has no approver identity: anyone with RBAC to resume the Workflow can approve; the reviewer list is lost)

job.if.note: DAG task when (the subset that the {{= expr }} printer writes becomes when; a status or result test becomes depends, and a task with continueOn or a need that may fail waits through depends; any other condition becomes when {{= false }} with a lost entry)

job.manual.note: suspend template as a gate task (anyone with RBAC to resume the Workflow can start the job)

job.matrix.note: DAG task withItems over the expanded cells (failFast and parallelism carry fail-fast and max-parallel only where they match; axis values become strings)

job.needs.artifacts.note: DAG task arguments artifacts from the needed task (the artifact repository ConfigMap is external; artifacts load only into a container named main)

job.outputs.note: template outputs parameters read from files under /workspace/.pipemaster/outputs (outputs load only from the container named main; a value is written by a last script line of that container, and a parameter name that is not a valid name is lost)

job.runner.note: (Argo schedules pods; only a platform label can carry a node selector)

job.services.note: template sidecars (the service is at localhost, not at its name)

job.timeout.note: template timeout (the timeout counts Pending time too)

pipeline.concurrency.note: synchronization mutex (cancel-in-progress is lost; a second run waits for the mutex)

pipeline.env.note: copied into the env of every container (a step variable of the same name wins)

pipeline.finally.note: exit handler (hooks.exit) that runs a second dag

pipeline.inputs.note: spec arguments parameters (every input is a string parameter)

pipeline.permissions.note: (permissions come from the ServiceAccount of the Workflow)

project.multi_pipeline.note: one WorkflowTemplate per IR pipeline (each pipeline gets its own trigger)

step.action.note: container image per actions.Lookup verdict (unknown actions are lost)

step.continue_on_error.note: script line trap 'exit 0' EXIT with a marker comment (containerSet has no continueOn and no depends; a container that exits non-zero stops its dependents, so the trap makes the exit code zero)

step.if.note: guard in the script that reads context values from env (containerSet has no when, so every step condition runs as a shell guard that reads context values from env; a condition with no guard form disables the script and the container still starts; a containerSet starts every container at once and each waits for its dependencies, and a container that exits non-zero stops its dependents)

step.shell.note: container command <shell> -ec (only bash, dash, zsh, ash and sh run as the container command, and the image must provide the shell; any other shell is lost and the script runs under sh)

step.timeout.note: (containerSet has no timeout per container; the template timeout covers the whole job)

trigger.api.note: Sensor trigger kept in the Ext data, or a suspended CronWorkflow (only a trigger that an Argo file held is written back; any other API trigger is lost, and the schedule of a suspended CronWorkflow is not in the IR)

trigger.filter.branches.note: Sensor data filter on body.ref (the EventSource is github and serves GitHub webhooks only; a glob becomes a regex and a glob with no exact regex is lost)

trigger.filter.paths.note: (a Sensor data filter cannot test the changed files of a push)

trigger.filter.tags.note: Sensor data filter on body.ref (the EventSource is github and serves GitHub webhooks only; a glob becomes a regex and a glob with no exact regex is lost)

trigger.manual.note: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/<name> (a person starts the run; the report names the command. The EventBus, the EventSource Service and Ingress, the artifact repository ConfigMap, the RBAC under .argo/rbac/, the ci-secrets Secret and the ci-vars ConfigMap values are external as well)

trigger.pull_request.note: EventSource and Sensor with a k8s trigger that creates a Workflow (the EventSource is github and serves GitHub webhooks only; the Sensor accepts pull requests from the same repository only, because a fork would run its code with every secret; the EventSource webhook needs Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token)

trigger.push.note: EventSource and Sensor with a k8s trigger that creates a Workflow (the EventSource is github and serves GitHub webhooks only; the Argo Events controller needs the EventBus and a ServiceAccount, and the EventSource Service needs an Ingress)

trigger.tag.note: EventSource and Sensor with a k8s trigger that creates a Workflow (the EventSource is github and serves GitHub webhooks only)

expr.opaque.note: (Concourse has no expression language, so every opaque expression is lost)

job.allow_failure.note: try around the plan (the job shows success, not failure)

job.artifacts.note: workspace artifact handed from task to task (inputs and outputs of the same name) (only within one job; a job with no script step writes no workspace)

job.env.note: copied into the params of every task (a step variable of the same name wins)

job.environment.note: (Concourse has no environment name or URL)

job.environment.approval.note: job with no triggering get, started by a person (Concourse has no approver identity: anyone who may trigger the job approves it, and the reviewer list is lost; a job whose get steps carry different trigger sets keeps the set in Ext[concourse][triggers], and a job whose get steps do not trigger is started by a person)

job.if.note: shared shell guard on script tasks; a status function becomes a job hook (on_failure or ensure) (a condition with no guard form leaves the job with no triggering get, so a person starts it, and adds a lost entry)

job.manual.note: job with no triggering get, started by a person (no approver identity; a job whose get steps carry different trigger sets keeps the set in Ext[concourse][triggers], and a job whose get steps do not trigger is started by a person)

job.needs.artifacts.note: s3 or registry-image resource between the jobs (the operator sets up the s3 or registry resource and its credentials; Concourse passes no artifact between jobs by itself)

pipeline.inputs.note: (a Concourse pipeline has no run-time inputs; fly set-pipeline vars apply at set time)

pipeline.permissions.note: (permissions come from the team and the credential manager)

project.multi_pipeline.note: one pipeline file per IR pipeline under .concourse/ (each pipeline needs its own fly set-pipeline and gets its own triggers)

step.action.note: task per actions.Lookup verdict (unknown actions are lost)

step.if.note: shared shell guard in the script of the task (a condition with no guard form runs as a task whose first script line is exit 0, with a lost entry)

An interval counts from the last version, so it has no clock alignment, the first check emits a version at once, and an every-minute cron cannot fire faster than the check cadence. A daily window is 5 minutes wide, so the job starts within 5 minutes after the cron time; a window that passes midnight is lost when it has a day list. source.text:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: golang:1.27
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [amd64, arm64]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: go vet ./...
      - run: GOARCH=${{ matrix.arch }} go test ./...
  deploy:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref_name == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: alpine:3.22
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh
        env:
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: EventSource
metadata:
  name: pipemaster-github
spec:
  github:
    pull_request:
      active: true
      contentType: json
      events:
        - pull_request
      repositories:
        - names:
            - REPO
          owner: OWNER
      webhook:
        endpoint: /pull_request
        method: POST
        port: "12000"
        url: ""
      webhookSecret:
        key: token
        name: pipemaster-github-webhook
    push:
      active: true
      contentType: json
      events:
        - push
      repositories:
        - names:
            - REPO
          owner: OWNER
      webhook:
        endpoint: /push
        method: POST
        port: "12000"
        url: ""
      webhookSecret:
        key: token
        name: pipemaster-github-webhook
  service:
    ports:
      - port: 12000
        targetPort: 12000

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Sensor
metadata:
  name: pipemaster
spec:
  dependencies:
    - eventName: pull_request
      eventSourceName: pipemaster-github
      filters:
        data:
          - path: body.action
            type: string
            value:
              - opened
              - reopened
              - synchronize
          - path: body.pull_request.base.ref
            type: string
            value:
              - ^main$
        exprs:
          - expr: head == base
            fields:
              - name: head
                path: body.pull_request.head.repo.full_name
              - name: base
                path: body.repository.full_name
      name: ci-pr
    - eventName: push
      eventSourceName: pipemaster-github
      filters:
        data:
          - path: body.ref
            type: string
            value:
              - ^refs/heads/main$
      name: ci-push
  template:
    serviceAccountName: pipemaster-sensor
  triggers:
    - template:
        conditions: ci-pr
        k8s:
          operation: create
          parameters:
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.0.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.pull_request.head.sha
                dependencyName: ci-pr
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.1.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.repository.full_name
                dependencyName: ci-pr
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.2.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.pull_request.head.ref
                dependencyName: ci-pr
          source:
            resource:
              apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
              kind: Workflow
              metadata:
                generateName: ci-
              spec:
                arguments:
                  parameters:
                    - name: ctx-sha
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-repo
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-ref-name
                      value: ""
                serviceAccountName: pipemaster-workflow
                workflowTemplateRef:
                  name: ci
        name: ci-pr
    - template:
        conditions: ci-push
        k8s:
          operation: create
          parameters:
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.0.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.after
                dependencyName: ci-push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.1.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.repository.full_name
                dependencyName: ci-push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.2.value
              src:
                dataTemplate: '{{ trimPrefix "refs/heads/" .Input.body.ref }}'
                dependencyName: ci-push
          source:
            resource:
              apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
              kind: Workflow
              metadata:
                generateName: ci-
              spec:
                arguments:
                  parameters:
                    - name: ctx-sha
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-repo
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-ref-name
                      value: ""
                serviceAccountName: pipemaster-workflow
                workflowTemplateRef:
                  name: ci
        name: ci-push
